name: Steam Community profile XML
tier_rationale: Valve Corporation, an established company with the published Steam Subscriber Agreement, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); P116 FC9 lists Valve (Steam) as trusted.

reliability.justification: The platform's own answer is authoritative for the existence and public fields of its accounts; profile fields (names, links, bios) are self-declared by the owner.

steam_community_xml.title: Steam Community profile XML (steamcommunity.com/id/{vanity}/?xml=1, /profiles/{steamid64}/?xml=1)

terms.quote: P116 FC4 (binding council text): documented public APIs (Chess.com PubAPI, Lichess, Mojang, Steam Community XML, Medium RSS, Pinterest widget, Stack Exchange API, Twitch Helix with the team's app) are 'open' once recorded; Snapchat __NEXT_DATA__ and the Disqus profile page are 'unknown' and stay disabled in every profile until legal records them (A1).

steam_community_xml.notes: Research C0258 (2026-11-25/26): always HTTP 200; FOUND iff <steamID64>, the <error> 'The specified profile could not be found.' = ABSENT, any other <error> is an error-in-200 (could not verify). Parsed with the module's safe XML helper (no DTD/entities). Vanity names are first-come: never assume brand ownership. Polite use (bursts may get 429). The Steam Web API key (V3LUM_STEAM_KEY) is not used by this build (no Web API call; docs/backlog/p3-G05-2.md).

notes: Batch p3-G05-2 (P116 steam_community_profile). Unpublished rate limit: 2 s between requests, one at a time. personal_data_review to be recorded before default use (A3 BR8).
